scope: First control-derived support mask for EPIC Ego H3 repair tournaments
summary: A 16-level difference threshold with large close/dilate kernels treated the source-hand cleanup halo as generated action support, covering about 57% of the frame and creating broad fog-like blending artifacts.
evidence: The window-00 and window-01 pour probes report mean support fractions of 0.5788 and 0.5698.
Seam-frame review shows diffuse generated/source mixtures far outside the robot arms and bottle.
lessons: Control-vs-source difference is not itself semantic action support when the control adapter also performs soft human cleanup.
limitations: Probe-v1 repaired outputs are not eligible for the final comparison.
next_actions: Raise the difference threshold and bound the morphology kernels, then rerun all six five-recipe probes.
